note: Textbook renderings that dominate training data but read badly to a normal reader. Every entry is editable project policy, not a law of the language: 'bad' is the discouraged rendering, 'good' lists accepted ones, and 'keep_english' terms should usually stay in Latin script. Confidence marks how safe the rule is to enforce automatically.

rules.note: 缺省 is a 1980s textbook calque; every modern product UI uses 默认.
鲁棒 is a pure transliteration of 'robust' and carries no meaning in Chinese.
In LLM contexts keep Token; in security contexts 令牌 is the established word.
高速缓存 is the hardware-textbook form; product text says 缓存.
时延 is telecom jargon; user-facing text says 延迟.
吞吐量 is the common rendering in engineering documentation.
因特网 is a phonetic relic of 1990s standards documents.
万维网 survives only in encyclopedias.
套接字 is standard in textbooks; developer-facing UI usually keeps Socket.
游标 belongs to database cursors, not to the text caret.
Avoid padded compounds in UI labels; short labels fit the width budget.
解析度 is the zh-TW form; zh-CN uses 分辨率.
视讯 is zh-TW; zh-CN uses 视频.
Locale drift from zh-TW into zh-CN output.
Locale drift from zh-TW into zh-CN output.
Locale drift from zh-TW into zh-CN output.
zh-CN product UI overwhelmingly uses 设置.
点选 is zh-TW usage.
储存 is zh-TW usage; zh-CN says 保存.
词嵌入 only fits word-level embeddings; keep Embedding for the general concept.

keep_english.note: LLM context; 词元 is discouraged.
提示词 is acceptable, but keep Prompt in developer UI.
Common in developer-facing text; 缺陷 in formal documents.
